product_results.description: Celebrate the countdown to Christmas with the LEGO City Advent Calendar 2026 (60510) building toy for kids ages 5 years old and up. The 2026 edition of this Christmas advent calendar is packed with 24 days of seasonal surprises, including mini builds and characters that bring a daily dose of delight and inspire creative play. Kids will discover several minifigures as they open the calendar, including Santa, Mrs. Claus, 3 elves and a snowman, plus a baby reindeer figure. This advent calendar for kids also contains buildable toys like a rocking horse and choo-choo train, plus fun North Pole accessories like carrot noses for snowmen (or reindeer snacks) and a cup of hot chocolate. What better place to put together builds than the place where the Christmas magic happens: Santa’s workshop! Kids can fold out the playmat on the box to reveal a Santa’s workshop scene. It’s the perfect place for aspiring elves to make (and play with) the toys they find each day in the calendar. This LEGO advent calendar makes a great pre-Christmas gift for boys, girls and anyone who loves celebrating the countdown to Christmas. Each surprise toy comes with easy step-by-step building instructions printed on the inside of its calendar window, so even new LEGO builders can enjoy a fun build-and-play experience. Kids can also combine the buildable toys, accessories and minifigures included in the LEGO City Advent Calendar 2026 with other playsets (each sold separately) from the LEGO City collection. Contains 252 pieces.

authors_reviews.title: The Ultimate North Pole Crew – A Massive Hit for Kids & Winter Villages!
authors_reviews.text: As someone who looks forward to the LEGO advent calendars every year, the 2026 LEGO City Advent Calendar (Set 60510) is an absolute home run. LEGO completely pivoted away from generic city filler builds and went all-in on a cohesive Santa's Workshop theme.The absolute best part is that you get TWO entirely different Santa minifigures!Here is why this set is a must-buy for December• A Complete North Pole Crew: Beyond the two Santas, the character density is unmatched for the price. You get a rare Mrs. Claus figure, three unique elves with great facial expressions, an adorable snowman minifigure in a winter sweater, and a brand-new baby reindeer figure.• Zero "Filler Day" Disappointment: Every door opens to a recognizable piece of the North Pole workshop. From the mini toy workbench and Christmas train to the mail station for letters to Santa, everything feels cinematic and useful.• Box Converts into a Playmat: The front flap folds down into a gorgeous illustration of Santa’s Workshop. Instead of the micro-builds cluttering up your counters, kids have a built-in backdrop to play out stories as they open a new door each morning.A Quick Tip for Parents: Because this set features a rare volume of the entire Claus family and their workshop crew in an affordable box, it is a massive hit with Adult Fans of LEGO (AFOLs) building winter villages. Grab it early on Amazon before the November/December price spikes!Final Verdict:With easy-to-follow instructions printed right inside the doors, it’s perfect for independent building for kids ages 5+. It trades licensed gimmicks for pure holiday magic. Highly recommended!
